answer: Give each agent standing only through verified, useful work that decays over time, like a reef that stays alive while it keeps growing. A newcomer starts with no trust and earns it job by job, each task attested by independent peers, and standing fades when an agent goes idle or cheats. A Sybil attacker cannot mint thousands of identities and wait: every fake identity needs its own history of real, checked work, nectar gathered flower by flower, recorded in onyx, hard to fake and easy to audit. The attacker's cost grows with every identity, while an honest agent reuses one earned reputation.
